summary: Completed testing of WishWay Sorteos new features: 500-ticket purchase limit, unlimited ticket display, and client dashboard restructure with summary/detail views and pagination. All 12 backend tests passed, 1 skipped. Frontend UI testing confirmed all features work correctly.
seed_data_creation: Purchased 520 test tickets (20 + 500) for user usuario@test.com on sorteo 7bd04188-d569-4ea0-953f-7a160ff7af05 to test pagination
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested features are fully functional: 1) Backend 500-ticket limit returns 400 error when exceeded. 2) /api/boletos/mis-boletos returns ALL tickets (no 1000 limit). 3) /api/boletos/mis-boletos/resumen returns summary grouped by sorteo with activos/pendientes counts. 4) /api/boletos/mis-boletos/sorteo/{id}?page=1&limit=15&estado=todos returns paginated tickets. 5) User dashboard shows summary cards grouped by raffle with 'Ver boletos' button. 6) Detail view shows paginated tickets with estado filter and back button. 7) Frontend SorteoLanding shows max=500 on input and validates limit. Test user has 520 pending boletos on sorteo 'mas de mil boletos'.
